scripts.build: bun build actions/release-notes/src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=actions/release-notes/dist/index.js && bun build actions/shipped-comments/src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=actions/shipped-comments/dist/index.js
scripts.check:dist: git ls-files --error-unmatch actions/release-notes/dist/index.js actions/shipped-comments/dist/index.js && bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- actions/release-notes/dist actions/shipped-comments/dist
